📝Kazakhstan Elections📝
What are the exit polls saying?

Preliminary results from three polling centers at once give victory to the "Justice" party (Adilet), while the "greens" and "communists" fail to enter parliament.

By the end of the day, results from official polls were published, according to which five parties may enter the future Kurultai. The overwhelming majority of mandates go to "Justice," which has become the de facto successor to the ruling AMANAT party that it absorbed earlier.

🖍Following with a significant gap, the parties entering parliament are: "Aul," Respublica, OSDP and "Ak Zhol." We analyzed in detail earlier what the programs and electorate of each of them represent. In any case, the total number of mandates will not allow the parties even in theory to form an opposition to the favorite.

🚩The result proved disappointing for the "People's Party of Kazakhstan," which, according to exit polls, fails to overcome the mandatory 5% threshold and risks dropping out of parliament for the first time in a decade and a half. In that case, the new Kurultai will lose the voice of the country's older generation.

📌It is too early to speak of official election results, but the picture is generally clear. Kazakhstan's future unicameral parliament is a completely loyal-to-Tokayev construct that allows faster implementation of reforms within the framework of the "New Kazakhstan" course.
